notes.summary: Manuscript page 64 asks when prescribed component figures come from one figure, adds condition C4, and records three corollaries with substantial cancellations and interlinear revisions. There are no mathematical diagrams, standalone drawings, detached margin notes, typed additions, title, date, or archive number visible on this sheet. The angular line around Cor. 2 is an insertion connector, represented by the insertion macro and documented in the inventory rather than treated as an independent figure.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No mathematical proposition was proved or tested. The analogous form of the three family maps prompted scrutiny of the final separator, but its visible one-stroke form was transcribed as a dash; no arrowhead was supplied from mathematical expectation. The two strokes after en est de were recorded literally as =, not expanded to même. Family alphabets and indices were read from each occurrence. The comparison used to decide des versus deux was a comparison of letter strokes within this page, not mathematical reasoning.
notes.author_checks: The inserted author wording says C’est néc et suffisant pour la validité des (validité remains uncertain in its first group). There is no visible author check mark or explicit verification instruction. This transcription does not claim that C4 or any corollary has been verified.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Only the handwritten page number 64 appears at top centre. The reading retains scanpage{65} and mspage{64}; no cote marker was added because this C fragment had none. No title or date is on the page.
notes.witness_encoding: Equivalent state macro names (struck/deleted, uncertain/unsure) and emph/uline for the same underline were not counted solely for syntax. The emptyset/varnothing rendering choice was likewise treated as the same handwritten slashed-oval sign. Family alphabet differences were counted because the brief explicitly requires alphabet fidelity.
